scope: D031 scene-specific continuity contract; working contract, not art approval

character.identity: Vishnu as the young brahmachari Vamana, later the same Lord in Trivikrama cosmic form.
character.anatomy: one distinct face, two attached arms and hands, two legs and feet; natural proportions for a short youthful adult.
character.iconography: simple ochre or saffron brahmachari dress, sacred thread, umbrella and staff when supported by scene; no peacock feather, flute, or Krishna-only marks.
character.trivikrama: same face and identity cues; giant scale and one coherent stride may span realms. Keep two-arm anatomy unless a specific scene contract requires otherwise.
character.style: flat opaque mineral matte pigment, dark drawn contours, painted ochre ornament, no gloss or metallic reflections.
